Mr. Ajay Kumar Thakur, the learned Advocate for the appellant/applicant presses the afore-noted interlocutory application, seeking suspension of sentence during the pendency of the present appeal.

sentences.text: 3. The written objection on behalf of the State is on record.

4. The appellant/applicant has been convicted under Section 376 AB of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 vide judgment dated 01.07.2023 in POCSO G.R. Case No.19 of 2019, arising out of Jalley P.S. Case No.48 of 2019.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
By order dated 05.07.2023, he has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for twenty years,
to pay fine of Rs.30,000/- and in default of payment of fine, he has further been sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for six months, under both the offences.

5. The appellant has renewed his prayer for suspension of sentence primarily on the ground of his having remained in jail since 2019 and at the time of judgment, his age was assessed to be 70 years by the Trial Court.
Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.800 of 2023(5) dt.10-01-2025 6.
The appellant is alleged to have committed rape on a seven years old girl, who was staying in her maternal uncle's home.

7. Several other mitigating features have been pointed out by Mr. Thakur, the learned Advocate for the appellant, but considering the nature of accusation against the appellant/applicant, we are not inclined to suspend his sentence during the pendency of the appeal.
8.
The prayer for suspension of sentence is, accordingly, rejected.
9. However, in obedience to the mandate of Section 374 (4) of the Cr.P.C., we deem it appropriate to give a final hearing to this case.

10. The Registry is directed to prepare the paper book with urgent dispatch and this case shall be listed for final hearing in the last week of February, 2025, commencing from 24th of February, 2025 within first five cases.
Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.800 of 2023(5) dt.10-01-2025 11.
I.A. No. 2 of 2024 stands disposed off accordingly.

(Ashutosh Kumar, J)
 (Alok Kumar Pandey, J)
